title: A pooling symmetry in solved Sudoku
overview_result: 15/16 encoding codes active with weighted pooling; generator agreement falls to 1.65%.
overview_interpretation: Encoding diagnosis; no generation improvement.
requirements: Sudoku assets; extraction arrays for weighted pooling

title: Reading and editing terminal codes
overview_result: 784/1,024 requested writes; 552/1,024 fresh puzzles certified by lookup + checker.
overview_interpretation: Partial terminal readout; no full-pipeline speedup established.
requirements: Sudoku assets, extraction arrays and discovery tables

title: Recovery and donor matching in GPT-2
overview_result: Recovery 1.910 nats; donor matching adds 0.038 nat at L9H9.
overview_interpretation: Recovery exceeds matching; compensation itself is already known.
requirements: GPT-2 checkpoint, selected IOI prompts and fresh local freezes

title: Two terminal edits can interfere
overview_result: Both targets written in 55.12% of 10,240 double edits.
overview_interpretation: Edits interfere; single-edit success does not imply composition.
requirements: Sudoku assets and terminal discovery tables

title: Token reversals in LM1B generation
overview_result: 416/2,340 selected positions leave the final token after reaching it at level 9.
overview_interpretation: Readouts are non-monotonic; codec controls also reverse.
requirements: LM1B model and tokenizer; selected oracle inputs

title: A correct intermediate digit can change again
overview_result: 25.04% of cells corrected at levels 8–9 become wrong later.
overview_interpretation: A correct intermediate digit is not a stable commitment.
requirements: Per-level Sudoku extraction arrays

title: An extra mismatch check did not improve prediction
overview_result: Coverage/risk: 50.52%/2.35%; without mismatch: 50.90%/2.34%.
overview_interpretation: No added benefit from the extra mismatch condition.
requirements: InterpBench weights, Tracr sources, dependencies and fresh seals

title: Repeating IOI interventions at two other heads
overview_result: Matching: 0.025 nat at L9H6; 0.008 nat at L10H0.
overview_interpretation: Positive effects; L10H0 does not clear the conventional 0.01-nat margin.
requirements: Same IOI assets and development gate as experiment 03

title: Omitting a residual did not establish specific repair
overview_result: Recovery −0.001641 nat; joint criterion fails.
overview_interpretation: Specific repair not established under this omission.
requirements: Sudoku assets and native extraction arrays

title: The initial NCM audit
overview_result: Naked-single probe AUROC 0.877; causal ablation not specific.
overview_interpretation: Decodability does not establish causal use of the feature.
requirements: Sudoku assets and original split inputs

title: The constant level did not recur in text tokenizers
overview_result: No constant native level in the examined text strata.
overview_interpretation: The Sudoku observation does not generalize to these text checks.
requirements: LM1B/TinyStories tokenizer assets and text data

title: Internal states added little to failure prediction
overview_result: Hidden-state contrast adds about 0.0043 AUROC; stronger observable baseline wins.
overview_interpretation: No convincing practical benefit from internal-state features.
requirements: Sudoku assets and training/development feature arrays

title: An abandonment policy saved too little
overview_result: Optimistic savings 2.29% at 10 lost solutions per 1,000; gate was 5%.
overview_interpretation: The tested early-abandonment policy is not worthwhile.
requirements: Experiment 12 training features and fitted baseline

title: Predicting which cell errors persist
overview_result: Predictive increment −0.00060; interval spans zero.
overview_interpretation: Local latent features do not help this fitted persistence predictor.
requirements: Sudoku assets, training features and development fits

title: A reader-only Pythia control
overview_result: Mean reader recovery −0.000601 nat; interval includes zero.
overview_interpretation: Structural identity checked; no average recovery established.
requirements: Pythia-160M checkpoint and WikiText inputs

title: Input and state exchanges in NCM
overview_result: 15/16 families input-dominant; frozen recipient tail also succeeds in 32/32 swaps.
overview_interpretation: Access-dependent diagnosis; regeneration benefit not established.
requirements: Sudoku assets and constructed Sudoku families from experiment 19

title: The same access test on GPT-2 copying
overview_result: 8/16 families pass native competence; 8 remain unidentified.
overview_interpretation: Protocol transfer, with limited evidence beyond it.
requirements: GPT-2 checkpoint and copying families

title: AR and parallel toy models on one task
overview_result: 6/6 models solve native examples; shared damage gate fails.
overview_interpretation: No valid general comparison of AR and parallel repair.
requirements: PyTorch/NumPy; fresh toy training and calibration

title: Checking the protocol on constructed programs
overview_result: 344/344 intended diagnoses on jointly designed instances.
overview_interpretation: Implementation consistency, not external mechanism validation.
requirements: NumPy/PyTorch for the fixed-family analytical rerun; no trained checkpoint required

title: Replacing the whole memory removes the recipient path
overview_result: Outputs follow the donor when all recipient state is removed.
overview_interpretation: Expected consequence of the access contract.
requirements: NumPy/PyTorch for structural; trained toy checkpoints from experiment 18 for evaluate
